summary: Exercise independent upstream delay and recovery with two miners and a late validator
details: Make delayed fake PoW asynchronous and cancellable so the test miner can replace obsolete work without blocking its task loop; the normal PoW path is unchanged.
Run real isolated Bitcoin, balance-history and indexer stores for three nodes, with distinct MinerPass owners and miner beneficiaries.

Require gossip and downloader recovery without chain restart or peer reconnection, competing-anchor fork convergence, historical reward equality, anchor exhaustion recovery and invalid-block rejection.
Add one-cycle nightly and three-cycle weekly acceptance shards, with RPC audits and bounded failure evidence. Delayed fake PoW is confined to these test fixtures.
